## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Verification

List commands run and results, including relevant native TV checks/screenshots. State what remains unverified on physical hardware.

- [ ] Changes are focused; new production dependencies were discussed first.
- [ ] Tests/checks appropriate to the change passed.
- [ ] Remote safety, background release and non-secret draft behavior remain intact where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, signing files, real camera footage or private raw logs are included.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated where needed.
